name: inspira-rainbow-button
blurb: Text cycles through rainbow colors on loop.
description: A button with text that animates through a rainbow color sequence using CSS keyframes.
use_when: You need a playful CTA that continuously draws attention.
avoid_when: On professional or minimal interfaces; the constant color change can feel distracting.
a11y: Standard button semantics. Color cycling is visual only. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
